rationale: The pain is real and structural — Azure Cost Management genuinely does not expose Foundry resource names for SaaS-type AI deployments — but evidence is thin: a single ServerFault post with no confirmed upvotes or peer corroboration found in adjacent searches. Willingness-to-pay is inferred from analogous tools (Apptio, CloudHealth) rather than demonstrated for this specific gap, and the build complexity (Azure OAuth, multi-tenant credential management, Cost Management + Foundry API reconciliation) puts it well beyond auto-operated tooling. Insufficient distinct pain quotes and no direct WTP signal; rejecting this cycle with a recommendation to re-scan after 60 days when Azure usage grows further.
